objective: Every actually scheduled agent role must produce one inspectable evidence-backed document per successful research cycle, and missing/failed work must be explicitly identified. All defined inactive identities remain a scheduling backlog, not imagined active workers.

coverage.primary_agents: 30 GitHub matrix jobs every scheduled cycle, including directors and independent assistants
coverage.director_managers: Each of 10 executing directors schedules 15 manager reviews and 2/50 workers per manager per cycle
coverage.descendants: Each actually attempted S, G and H role with report data gets its own document; no document claims for billions of unrun definitions
coverage.no_false_activity: No document for an unexecuted role may say it performed research or AI inference.

required_sections: What actually happened, including execution/model/source status
Verified cryptocurrency receipts only if externally substantiated

pipeline.reporting: Status and genuine evidence, not synthetic model output or imaginary received cryptocurrency

automation_limits.scheduled: GitHub Actions scheduled jobs may be delayed, cancelled or fail; every actually completed job with accessible outputs should produce documents.
automation_limits.unrun_roles: Not a completed delivery; report these as unscheduled configured roles.
automation_limits.model_failures: Document the source checks if available; explicitly mark model failure, not success.
automation_limits.money: Neither report count nor lead count is money. Count payments only after independent chain or account confirmation.
